Ann can’t be too early because Elif before Ann and Cara before Elif. So Cara < Elif < Ann.

Minimum: Cara=1, Elif=2, Ann=3. Then Ben=4.

Check Ann=3, Ben=4:

- Ben & Finn ≥3 apart: Finn ≤1 or ≥7. But 1 taken by Cara, so Finn ≥7.
- Ben & Ivo ≥3 apart: Ivo ≤1 or ≥7. 1 taken, so Ivo ≥7.
- Ben & Dev ≥3 apart: Dev ≤1 or ≥7. 1 taken, so Dev ≥7.

- Dev & Gus ≥3 apart, Dev before Gus: If Dev=7, Gus ≥10 impossible. So Dev can’t be 7 if Gus ≤9. Dev=7 → Gus≥10 impossible. So Dev must be ≤ Ann-3=0 impossible. So Ann=3 fails because Dev must be ≥7 but then Gus impossible.

- Ben & Finn ≥3 apart: Finn ≤2 or ≥8. ≤2 maybe taken, so Finn ≥8.

- Dev & Gus ≥3 apart, Dev before Gus: If Dev=8, Gus≥11 impossible. Dev=8 fails. So Dev can’t be ≥8 if Gus ≤9. Dev=8 → Gus≥11 impossible. So Ann=4 fails.

- Ben & Dev ≥3 apart: Dev ≤3 or ≥9. Dev=9 possible.
- Ann & Dev ≥3 apart: Ann=5, Dev ≤2 or ≥8. Dev=9 works.
- Dev & Gus ≥3 apart, Dev before Gus: Dev=9 impossible (Gus after). So Dev ≤2.

So Dev ≤2.

Also Ann & Gus ≥3 apart: Ann=5, Gus ≥8 or ≤2. Gus after Ben=6, so Gus ≥8.

Cara ≤3, Elif ≤4, Ann=5, Ben=6.

- Dev & Gus ≥3 apart, Dev before Gus: Dev ≤3, Gus ≥ Dev+3.
- Ann & Gus ≥3 apart: Ann=6, Gus ≥9 or ≤3. Gus after Ben=7, so Gus ≥9. Only Gus=9 possible.

So Gus=9.

Dev before Gus, Dev ≤3, Dev & Gus ≥3 apart: Gus=9, Dev ≤6, but Dev ≤3 OK.

Then Ivo=3.
